business_problem: As a mission-driven company operating in the fast-paced consumer goods industry, Newman’s Own needed to streamline internal operations to better serve its philanthropic goals. By adopting Microsoft 365 Copilot, the company increased creativity, effectiveness, and efficiency—freeing up employees’ time to focus on strategic storytelling and impact.
solution_summary: As a mission-driven company operating in the fast-paced consumer goods industry, Newman’s Own needed to streamline internal operations to better serve its philanthropic goals. By adopting Microsoft 365 Copilot, the company increased creativity, effectiveness, and efficiency—freeing up employees’ time to focus on strategic storytelling and impact. After embedding Copilot across departments—from marketing and legal to logistics and finance—the results were immediate: faster workflows, clearer communication, and more time spent on purpose-driven work. With Copilot embedded in employees’ daily tools, Newman’s Own is scaling its mission with greater productivity and clarity—laying the groundwork for future innovation in how they communicate, collaborate, and give back.

By adopting Microsoft 365 Copilot, the company increased creativity, effectiveness, and efficiency—freeing up employees’ time to focus on strategic storytelling and impact.

Best reinforces how Copilot is a key part of the company’s money-saving plans because the team is gaining time and productivity efficiencies. Copilot is an integral part of how Newman’s Own has been able to give even more to help children in need. Best concludes, “Nothing could be better than helping more kids, and that’s what Copilot allows us to do.”

After embedding Copilot across departments—from marketing and legal to logistics and finance—the results were immediate: faster workflows, clearer communication, and more time spent on purpose-driven work. With Copilot embedded in employees’ daily tools, Newman’s Own is scaling its mission with greater productivity and clarity—laying the groundwork for future innovation in how they communicate, collaborate, and give back.
"Using Copilot and AI to its fullest potential so we can be smarter than our competition is a key piece of our recipe for success."

Newman’s Own is in the highly competitive food industry, making an array of products, from sauces to snacks, drinks to dog treats. The company continues Paul Newman’s founding commitment to “give it all away,” with 100% of its profits going to Newman’s Own Foundation, whose mission is to nourish and transform the lives of children who face adversity.
